title: GDPR and the EU AI Act

videos.script: Ipê opens a small company in Lisbon. Vitamins and cosmetics, four people in a warehouse, the orders in the same database in São Paulo. {{lisbon}} That one decision brings in two European laws. The GDPR, because the company is established in the Union. And the AI Act, because a chatbot answering Portuguese customers and a tool ranking applicants for the warehouse are used there. {{two-laws}} Most of the GDPR will feel familiar after the LGPD. The numbers are where the mistakes are. A breach known on a Friday evening is due at the Portuguese regulator on Monday, and at the Brazilian one on Thursday. {{clocks}} The AI Act sorts systems by what they are used for. Ipê has four. One is high-risk, and nobody answers for it. {{inventory}} And the schedule of the Act changed this year, by a second regulation. {{omnibus}} This lesson reads both laws as somebody who runs the data, and shows which dates were checked, and when. {{end}}
